_what: DD-35 made mechanical (operator 2026-10-13: "dont change the range"). The sha256-16 of every top-level definition that belongs to THE RANGE alone, in the served deck, plus the predicate that DEFINES the range (chNum), the seat switcher (applyMode) and the overhead map painter. tests/range-frozen.test.mjs refuses a deck in which any of them has changed. Shared functions the Capital is REQUIRED to reuse are deliberately absent - their range-facing behaviour is held by the 241-row boot QA at four viewports, by the row THE_RANGE_DRAWS_WHAT_IT_DREW, and by the two play-throughs.
since: r.207 - every hash under spans is byte-identical to the r.207 deck, which is the proof that r.208 did not touch the range. pinnedAt is the revision at which they last changed ON PURPOSE; a revision that moves none of them never edits this file.
_movedWhy: Three definitions DID move in r.208, each declared rather than quietly re-based. goRange: leaving CH0 for a challenge has always set state.phase=static and zeroed the hits, and goRange never put them back - so after a round trip the range fired PASS - MOVING TARGETS at the next quota hit. That is r.207s own behaviour through its challenge picker; r.208 adds a second door onto it, so it is CLOSED here and the range is handed back whole. mapCam and drawMap: over a non-range channel the overhead view rises from 155 m to 2,400 m and looks straight down, because the deck has one focal length and 500 m of grounds cannot be framed any other way, and the caption says which site it shows - both under a chNum() guard, with the range keeping its own height, tilt and words. R.216: MAG_FILL_TOP and MAG_PNG moved, declared. His own r0.178 screenshot measures the fill starting 6.7% from the top of the drawing at 30 rounds; the served r.215 measured 39.2%, blank for its top 39%. r.203 moved MAG_FILL_TOP 11.3 -> 32.0 deliberately to put the bars below the witness window, and no gate anywhere asked whether a full magazine READS full, so it stayed wrong for thirteen revisions with every gate green. r.216 re-lays HIS OWN BAR at a closer pitch so exactly thirty fit from the body top to the floor: MAG_FILL_TOP 32.0 -> 6.5, MAG_BARS 19 -> 30, and the three fill rasters in MAG_PNG are the re-laid ones. These two definitions ARE the magazine; the freeze protects the RANGE behaviour, which is untouched - every other frozen definition is unchanged and both play-throughs are byte-identical.
